# CheckStock

FastAPI application for marketplace catalogs, stock, sales, unit economics, and integrations with Wildberries, Ozon, and Yandex Market.

## Start here

- [LLM wiki](docs/llm-wiki.md): code map, data flow, source-of-truth rules, and verification commands.
- [Documentation index](docs/README.md): all topic-specific guides.
- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md): application layers and dependencies.
- [Project README](README.md): local and Docker startup.

The documentation is a guide to the repository. For current behavior, verify the implementation, tests, configuration, and the running application's OpenAPI schema.
